English: The matched normal is the same jaw, teeth and nerve. Only the wisdom tooth is changed: it is replaced by an upright third molar in line with the second molar, at the same biting level. Its shape is the second molar scaled to 92%, with roots 20% shorter, so the roots stay at least 1.5 mm from the nerve. This is an approximation: real third molars are usually smaller than second molars, with more variable crowns and often fused roots,[10] and the front edge of the ramus still slightly overlaps the back of the crown. An erupted wisdom tooth can still have roots near the nerve; this normal shows one typical arrangement.
